audit.why: HARD at 8/10 fits the 47.77% over 247 games in the page's win-rate table. Snip Snip! is 6.5 seconds at rank 1 with true damage in the centre, and Hallowed Mist removes her from your targeting entirely, so a melee CC tank has no reliable way to start a fight before 6.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept. See notes for a win-rate discrepancy against the audit packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 4-5 spike says 'track her W cooldown timer' without ever giving the timer, and the Skip 'n Slash spike ignores that the dash partially refunds itself.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s — long enough that a whole wave passes between uses, which is what makes the advice actionable. Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s and Riot adds 'If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded', so her escape is on a shrinking timer whenever she is landing hits, exactly as it is for Graves.
audit.corrected: Both numbers and the refund written into whys[3], wants.foe[2] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never states the mechanic that decides this matchup, and directly contradicts the full layer, which does. Content says to land Arctic Assault 'outside Hallowed Mist range'. Also: 'Gwen's Snip Snip needs needle charges she hasn't stacked yet' and 'Stack Gwen's passive needle stacks' invent a resource, and Glacial Prison is called a comet three times.
audit.why: Riot on Hallowed Mist: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' The counterplay is to step INTO the mist — inside it she is targetable again, which matters enormously to Sejuani because Permafrost is a targeted 560-range stun that simply cannot be cast on her from outside. Telling the player to attack from outside the mist is the exact opposite of the correct play. Riot on Snip Snip!: 'Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times' — the six snips are part of one cast, not a stacked resource, and A Thousand Cuts is a passive with no charges. Riot on Glacial Prison: 'Sejuani throws her bola'.
audit.corrected: Step-into-the-mist stated in whys[2], wants.you[0], wants.foe[0] and early; the invented needle charges removed; bola replaces comet.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns correctly identifies Hallowed Mist as matchup-defining and correctly says 'untargetable from outside the mist', but gives no cooldown.
audit.corrected: The 22 seconds written in, and the untargetability turned into an instruction (walk in) rather than a warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun, no heal named, no item named.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts is her passive: bonus magic damage based on target health, and 'She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.' Against a tank with a large health pool that heal is at its strongest, which makes Grievous Wounds unusually valuable here rather than optional. Skip 'n Slash also grants attack speed and on-hit magic damage, so flat armour reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Thornmail named and tied to A Thousand Cuts, with the note that her damage scales off your own health pool.

edits.after: At Level 1 neither of you wants a straight trade — Snip Snip! deals true damage in the centre of its cone, so take W, hit your wave, and give nothing. Level 2 changes it: Arctic Assault means you can threaten a knock-up if she stands forward at the minion line, and the threat alone forces her to respect the angle. Hit Level 3 first if you can — the full Q-W-E chain punishes her for stepping up to shove without Hallowed Mist available. And if she does drop the mist, do not back off: from outside it she cannot be targeted at all, so walk into the cloud, where she is targetable again, and finish the chain there.
edits.before: At Level 1 neither of you wants a straight trade — Gwen's Q true damage tips early exchanges her way, so take W, hit your wave, and give nothing. Level 2 changes the dynamic: Arctic Assault coming online means you can threaten a knock-up if she stands too far forward at the minion line, and the threat alone forces her to respect the brush angle. Hit Level 3 first if possible — the full Q-W-E chain lets you punish her if she steps up to shove the wave without popping Hallowed Mist: assault through her, land both W strikes, and shatter with E before the mist animation completes.

edits.after: From Levels 4 to 5 you are in a neutral window: Hallowed Mist counters your Arctic Assault pattern on a 22-second cooldown, and Skip 'n Slash resets trades while Permafrost is building. Play the wave — shove, back, keep items even. Level 6 is your reclaim moment: Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola, and thrown before she drops the mist there is nothing for her to hide behind. Land it while she is shove-extended or chasing, follow with the full chain, and the kill or at minimum a Flash is yours. Every jungle visit is now a kill window.
edits.before: From Levels 4 to 5 you are in a neutral window: Gwen's Hallowed Mist is reliably countering your Arctic Assault-into-W pattern if she respects the cooldown, and her E dash lets her reset trades when Permafrost is building. Play the wave — shove, back, keep items even. Level 6 is your reclaim moment: Glacial Prison is a ranged projectile she cannot hide in Hallowed Mist from if you throw it before she pops the bubble. Land the comet when she is shove-extended or chasing, follow with the full chain, and the kill or at minimum a flash is yours. Every jungle visit is a guaranteed kill window.

edits.after: With Sunfire Aegis and a second tank item your CC uptime is terrifying in any 5v5, but Riftmaker plus Nashor's Tooth makes the solo duel dangerous — A Thousand Cuts scales off your health and heals her for a share of it, so Grievous Wounds is mandatory, not optional, on a tank build. Use Glacial Prison to start objectives and teamfights, never to chase her alone. She cannot mist an entire team; your job is to land R in the backline and let your team clean up, not to out-duel her in a side lane.
edits.before: With Sunfire Aegis and a second tank item your CC uptime is terrifying in any 5v5, but Gwen's Riftmaker plus Nashor's Tooth means the solo duel is increasingly dangerous — her true damage works through your resistances in a way most top laners cannot match. Use Glacial Prison to start objectives and teamfights, not to chase Gwen alone. She cannot pop Hallowed Mist on an entire team; your job is to land R in the backline or midline and let your team clean up, not to out-duel her in a side lane where her scaling wins.

notes: The most important correction in this slice. The content layer told the player to engage 'outside Hallowed Mist range' and to land Arctic Assault 'outside Hallowed Mist range' — the exact inverse of Riot's mechanic, which is that she can ONLY be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Sejuani's Permafrost is a targeted 560-range stun, so from outside the mist her entire win condition is uncastable; the correct instruction is to walk in. Note that the full layer already had this right ('Untargetable from outside the mist'), so the two layers of the same page were telling the player opposite things. Also removed an invented resource — 'needle charges' and 'passive needle stacks' — Snip Snip! is a six-snip cone on one cast and A Thousand Cuts has no stacks. WIN-RATE DISCREPANCY: the page table gives 47.77% over 247 games; the audit packet gives 60.0% over 80 games. The page's own larger sample was used and the HARD 8/10 rating left alone, but the two sources disagree by twelve points. See questionsForUser.
